stratifiers.breakpointPolicy: Pre-defined categories only. No data-derived binning, so STRAT-08 is satisfied by construction.

determinism.seedPolicy: No stochastic step: IQR quantiles, Spearman and Pearson correlation, Kruskal-Wallis and Benjamini-Hochberg are all deterministic. Any future bootstrap (RED-06, STRAT-06 and STRAT-07) must record its seed here.
determinism.orderPolicy: Metrics in metric_config order; stratifier candidates and their levels in registry-declared order, never data order; redundancy pairs by descending absolute Spearman.

records.subject: chem_COND|chem_PH
records.reviewer_rationale: Both metrics retained. Conductivity reads ionic disturbance monotonically and pH reads two-sided acid-base suitability; the strong correlation (rho 0.864) likely reflects shared geology rather than a duplicated signal, so removing one would lose a mechanistically distinct line of evidence. Retention recorded with the SELECT-01 approval for water-soil-quality.

records.subject: phab_LRBS_use
records.reviewer_rationale: Accepted with the flag. The degenerate classification itself was an engine guard misfire on this signed log scale, fixed as iqr-seed-2 at this gate; the influence movement (21 percent) carries no decision flip.

records.subject: phab_LSUB_DMM
records.reviewer_rationale: Accepted with the flag. No decision flip; log substrate diameter spans coarse mountain and fine valley reaches, so one coarse site moves the upper quartile at n=33.

records.subject: phab_LWDeqVolM100
records.reviewer_rationale: Accepted with the flag. The largest movement (86 percent) with no decision flip and shape stability 0.985; large-wood volume is strongly right-skewed, and one wood-rich reach dominates the IQR at n=33. The driver is a valid reference site.

records.subject: phab_PCT_SAFN

records.subject: damdensws
